say:0:1061101001:0.source_cn: 那群黑衣服的人躲哪去了！

say:1:1061102001:1.text: Why have there been so many outlanders in Vaduso lately?
say:1:1061102001:1.source_cn: 最近瓦度索怎么来了这么多外人……
say:1:1061102001:1.male: Why have there been so many outlanders in Vaduso lately?
say:1:1061102001:1.female: Why have there been so many outlanders in Vaduso lately?

say:2:1061102002:1.text: Young man, did you see a bunch of men in black? They're stoutly built and armed.
say:2:1061102002:1.source_cn: 年轻人，我问问你，你在附近有没有见过一群穿着黑色衣服，...
say:2:1061102002:1.male: Young man, did you see a bunch of men in black? They're stoutly built and armed.
say:2:1061102002:1.female: Young lady, did you see a bunch of men in black? They're stoutly built and armed.

choice_prompt:3:1061102002.text: Young man, did you see a bunch of men in black? They're stoutly built and armed.
choice_prompt:3:1061102002.source_cn: 年轻人，我问问你，你在附近有没有见过一群穿着黑色衣服，身体很强壮，还带着武器的人类？

choice_prompt:3:1061102002.female: Young lady, did you see a bunch of men in black? They're stoutly built and armed.

say:4:1061102003:1.text: Henchman? Yeah, they looked like evil henchmen.
say:4:1061102003:1.source_cn: 打手？哼，我就知道，他们肯定不是什么好东西！
say:4:1061102003:1.male: Henchman? Yeah, they looked like evil henchmen.
say:4:1061102003:1.female: Henchman? Yeah, they looked like evil henchmen.

say:5:1061102004:1.text: I caught them spying for the village in the woods a few days ago, and they did it again today! What do they want?
say:5:1061102004:1.source_cn: 好几天前我就看见他们了，藏在树林里，没事就偷偷往村里看...
say:5:1061102004:1.male: I caught them spying for the village in the woods a few days ago, and they did it again today! What do they want?
say:5:1061102004:1.female: I caught them spying for the village in the woods a few days ago, and they did it again today! What do they want?

say:6:1061102005:1.text: Too bad they ran away too fast... Well, if I were younger, I'd give them a good drubbing!
say:6:1061102005:1.source_cn: 只可惜他们跑得太快……唉，要不是我年纪大了，非得冲上去...
say:6:1061102005:1.male: Too bad they ran away too fast... Well, if I were younger, I'd give them a good drubbing!
say:6:1061102005:1.female: Too bad they ran away too fast... Well, if I were younger, I'd give them a good drubbing!

say:7:1061102006:1.text: You seem like a young man. Could you help us chase the bad guys away?
say:7:1061102006:1.source_cn: 年轻人，你看着心善，能帮我个忙，把那群坏家伙赶走吗？
say:7:1061102006:1.male: You seem like a young man. Could you help us chase the bad guys away?
say:7:1061102006:1.female: You seem like a young lady. Could you help us chase the bad guys away?

choice_prompt:8:1061102006.male: You seem like a young man. Could you help us chase the bad guys away?
choice_prompt:8:1061102006.female: You seem like a young lady. Could you help us chase the bad guys away?

say:9:1061102007:1.text: Those rascals think my eyes were playing tricks on me, but listen good, I see fine. There's a bunch of suspicious folks around!
say:9:1061102007:1.source_cn: 哼，那些小崽子总觉得我老眼昏花，指定是看错了。但我和你...
say:9:1061102007:1.male: Those rascals think my eyes were playing tricks on me, but listen good, I see fine. There's a bunch of suspicious folks around!
say:9:1061102007:1.female: Those rascals think my eyes were playing tricks on me, but listen good, I see fine. There's a bunch of suspicious folks around!

say:10:1061102008:1.text: But you can't really blame them for being lazy. Strange happenings have been going on in the village. It's got everyone frazzled.
say:10:1061102008:1.source_cn: 不过，也不能怪年轻人懒惰。最近村里发生了太多怪事，大家...
say:10:1061102008:1.male: But you can't really blame them for being lazy. Strange happenings have been going on in the village. It's got everyone frazzled.
say:10:1061102008:1.female: But you can't really blame them for being lazy. Strange happenings have been going on in the village. It's got everyone frazzled.

say:11:1061102009:1.text: Think of it as a favor to bring me some peace of mind.
say:11:1061102009:1.source_cn: 你就当是让我心安，帮我这个忙吧。
say:11:1061102009:1.male: Think of it as a favor to bring me some peace of mind.
say:11:1061102009:1.female: Think of it as a favor to bring me some peace of mind.

choice:8:0:1.text: Why haven't the young folks done anything?
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 为什么不让村里年轻人去？
choice:8:0:1.male: Why haven't the young folks done anything?
choice:8:0:1.female: Why haven't the young folks done anything?

say:13:1061102010:1.text: I thought you were a nice young man!
say:13:1061102010:1.source_cn: 嗬，我这刚还夸你心善呢！
say:13:1061102010:1.male: I thought you were a nice young man!
say:13:1061102010:1.female: I thought you were a nice young lady!

say:14:1061102011:1.text: Alright, for the sake of the village's safety, I'll pay you myself.
say:14:1061102011:1.source_cn: 好吧，好吧，只要保证村子平平安安，我自掏腰包也没什么大...
say:14:1061102011:1.male: Alright, for the sake of the village's safety, I'll pay you myself.
say:14:1061102011:1.female: Alright, for the sake of the village's safety, I'll pay you myself.

say:15:1061102012:1.text: I'll leave you to it then.
say:15:1061102012:1.source_cn: 呵呵，那这事就拜托你了。
say:15:1061102012:1.male: I'll leave you to it then.
say:15:1061102012:1.female: I'll leave you to it then.

choice:8:2:3.text: Time to teach them a lesson.
choice:8:2:3.source_cn: 我正好准备教训他们一顿
choice:8:2:3.male: Time to teach them a lesson.
choice:8:2:3.female: Time to teach them a lesson.

say:1:1061103001:1.text: You're back. Did you chase off the bad guys?

say:1:1061103001:1.female: You're back. Did you chase off the bad guys?

say:3:1061103002:1.source_cn: 哎呀，那我就放心了。你真是个可靠的孩子，比我们村里这些...
